name: Signify Business Cash Card

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases. After that, variable APR of 16.74% – 24.74%.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not mentioned on product page.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 2% cash rewards on purchases for your business – without caps or spending categories.

rewards.redemption_notes: Apply cash rewards as a statement credit to an eligible account. Rewards do not expire as long as account remains open.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $500 cash rewards bonus when you spend $5,000 in purchases for your business in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Employee Cards at No Additional Cost
benefits.description: Add employee cards at no additional cost. Set employee spending limits, monitor cards, and track expenses with customizable instant alerts.

benefits.title: Priority Pass
benefits.description: Complimentary membership access to more than 1,300 participating airport lounges worldwide with 'pay as you go' lounge visit fees.

benefits.title: Worldwide Automatic Common Carrier Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Get Travel Accident Insurance protection of up to $250,000 when you purchase your airline or other common carrier ticket with your eligible credit card.

benefits.title: MasterRental Insurance Coverage
benefits.description: Drive with extra confidence when traveling for business, here or abroad, knowing you're protected against damage to, or theft of, a vehicle rented using your Signify Business Cash Card.

benefits.title: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.description: Built-in protection features ensure that you won't be held responsible for unauthorized transactions, as long as they're reported promptly.

benefits.title: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
benefits.description: Detection and protection against identity theft, including monitoring, alerts, and expert resolution 24/7/365. Enrollment is required.

benefits.title: Mastercard Business Assistant
benefits.description: Efficient & expert assistance, 24/7 — from arranging business travel or meetings, to recommending restaurants or office equipment upgrades.

lounge_access.notes: Priority Pass complimentary membership (pay-as-you-go visit fees)

notes: Network corrected from amex to mastercard based on page references to 'Signify Business Cash World Elite Mastercard® Credit Card Guide to Benefits' and Mastercard-branded benefits. network_tier set to world_elite. FX fee not mentioned on page.
